verdict.rationale: Crossmint is documented as API-first: wallets, payments, checkout, onramp/offramp, and agent-card flows are all exposed as REST APIs with live browser-testable reference docs (crossmint-docs-19, -33, -7, -26, -32), and headless checkout explicitly promises 'full control of the user experience' as an alternative to the embedded iframe UI. This strongly implies API/UI parity for core flows, but the evidence never explicitly confirms that every UI-only feature (e.g., dashboard-configured policy engine, project settings) has a matching API endpoint. Missing for 10: explicit statement or documentation mapping dashboard-only settings (like the policy engine) to API equivalents, and independent confirmation that no UI-exclusive features exist.
